ei.title: The Social Role of TV Sitcoms

fullPassage: Since their start in the early 1950s U.S. television sitcoms have charted many of the social conflicts in U.S. society: civil rights, women's rights in the home and in the workplace, children's rights, immigration and multiculturalism, as well as evolving conceptions of the family. Each of these issues has been addressed through humour in a way that has helped to make more progressive values more acceptable than previously. Often a character, usually someone marked as a bigot, resisted one or more of these developments and was then made to appear ridiculous. They were cut down either through their own stupidity, a brief scolding from others, or both. In this way, the humour of sitcoms acted as a cost-effective means to encourage acceptance of a more pluralistic and tolerant society.

questions.passage: Since their start in the early 1950s U.S. television sitcoms have charted many of the social conflicts in U.S. society: civil rights, women's rights in the home and in the workplace, children's rights, immigration and multiculturalism, as well as ①<u>evolving</u> conceptions of the family. Each of these issues has been addressed through humour in a way ②<u>that</u> has helped to make more progressive values more acceptable than previously. Often a character, usually someone ③<u>marked</u> as a bigot, resisted one or more of these developments and was then made to appear ridiculous. They were cut down either through their own stupidity, a brief scolding from others, or both. In this way, the humour of sitcoms acted as a cost-effective means to encourage acceptance of a more pluralistic and tolerant society.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ making → made. 'was then made to appear'에서 수동태 구조이므로 과거분사 made가 적절.
det.analysis:
❌ ① evolving: 현재분사로 conceptions 수식. 적절.
❌ ② that: 주격 관계대명사. a way를 수식. 적절.
❌ ③ marked: 과거분사. someone을 수식(수동). 적절.
✅ ④ making → made: was then ___에서 수동태(be + p.p.). making은 현재분사로 부적절.
det.tip: be + p.p. 수동태: was made (O) / was making (X, 진행형 의미가 됨)

questions.passage: Since their start in the early 1950s U.S. television sitcoms have charted many of the social conflicts in U.S. society: civil rights, women's rights in the home and in the workplace, children's rights, immigration and multiculturalism, as well as evolving conceptions of the family. Each of these issues ①<u>has been addressed</u> through humour in a way that has helped ②<u>to make</u> more progressive values more acceptable than previously. Often a character, usually someone marked as a bigot, resisted one or more of these developments and was then made to appear ridiculous. They were cut down either through their own stupidity, a brief scolding from others, or both. In this way, the humour of sitcoms acted as a cost-effective means to ④<u>encourage</u> acceptance of a more pluralistic and tolerant society.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ was acted → acted. act as는 자동사이므로 수동태 불가.
det.analysis:
❌ ① has been addressed: 현재완료 수동태. Each(단수)에 맞음. 적절.
❌ ② to make: help+(to)+V. 적절.
✅ ③ was acted → acted: act as = ~로 작용하다(자동사). 수동태 불가.
❌ ④ encourage: to encourage = to부정사. 적절.
det.tip: act as(~로 작용하다)는 자동사 구문. 수동태 X.

questions.passage: Since their start in the early 1950s U.S. television sitcoms have charted many of the social conflicts in U.S. society: civil rights, women's rights in the home and in the workplace, children's rights, immigration and multiculturalism, as well as evolving conceptions of the family. Each of these issues has been addressed through humour in a way that has helped to make more progressive values more acceptable than previously. Often a character, usually someone marked as a bigot, resisted one or more of these developments and was then made ①<u>to appear</u> ridiculous. They were ②<u>cut down</u> either through their own stupidity, a brief scolding from others, or both. In this way, the humour of sitcoms acted as a cost-effective means ③<u>to encourage</u> acceptance of a more pluralistic and ④<u>tolerating</u> society.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ tolerating → tolerant. society를 수식하는 형용사 tolerant가 적절. tolerating은 '참고 있는'의 의미.
det.analysis:
❌ ① to appear: 수동태에서 사역동사 make의 보어로 to부정사. 적절.
❌ ② cut down: 과거분사. were cut down 수동태. 적절.
❌ ③ to encourage: to부정사의 형용사적 용법으로 means 수식. 적절.
✅ ④ tolerating → tolerant: 형용사 tolerant가 society를 수식. tolerating은 현재분사로 '참고 있는' 의미이므로 부적절.
det.tip: tolerant(형용사: 관용적인) vs tolerating(현재분사: 참고 있는). a tolerant society (O)

questions.passage: Since their start in the early 1950s U.S. television sitcoms have charted many of the social conflicts in U.S. society: civil rights, women's rights in the home and in the workplace, children's rights, immigration and multiculturalism, as well as evolving conceptions of the family. Each of these issues has been ①<u>addressed</u> through humour in a way that has helped to make more progressive values more ②<u>acceptable</u> than previously. Often a character, usually someone marked as a bigot, ③<u>embraced</u> one or more of these developments and was then made to appear ridiculous. In this way, the humour of sitcoms acted as a cost-effective means to encourage ④<u>acceptance</u> of a more pluralistic and tolerant society.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ embraced(수용했다) → resisted(저항했다). 편견적 인물은 변화에 '저항'한 것이지 '수용'한 것이 아님.
det.analysis:
❌ ① addressed: 다루었다. 적절.
❌ ② acceptable: 수용 가능한. 적절.
✅ ③ embraced → resisted: 원문은 resisted(저항했다). embraced(수용했다)는 반의어.
❌ ④ acceptance: 수용. 적절.
det.tip: resist(저항하다) ↔ embrace(수용하다)

questions.passage: Since their start in the early 1950s U.S. television sitcoms have charted many of the social conflicts in U.S. society: civil rights, women's rights in the home and in the workplace, children's rights, immigration and multiculturalism, as well as ①<u>evolving</u> conceptions of the family. Each of these issues has been addressed through humour in a way that has helped to make more ②<u>progressive</u> values more acceptable than previously. Often a character, usually someone marked as a bigot, resisted one or more of these developments and was then made to appear ③<u>admirable</u>. They were cut down either through their own stupidity, a brief scolding from others, or both. questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ admirable(존경할 만한) → ridiculous(우스꽝스러운). 편견적 인물은 '존경'이 아닌 '우스꽝스럽게' 보임.
det.analysis:
❌ ① evolving: 진화하는. 적절.
❌ ② progressive: 진보적인. 적절.
✅ ③ admirable → ridiculous: 원문은 ridiculous. admirable은 반의어.
❌ ④ pluralistic: 다원적인. 적절.
det.tip: ridiculous(우스꽝스러운) ↔ admirable(존경할 만한)

det.korean: 가족에 대한 진화하는 '개념'이라는 문맥에서 conceptions이 적절.
det.analysis:
✅ ② conceptions: 개념. 가족에 대해 변화하는 '개념'. 적절.
❌ ① regulations: 규정. 부자연스러움.
❌ ③ restrictions: 제한. 부적절.

questions.stem: 윗글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 시트콤 유머가 cost-effective means(비용 효율적인 수단)로 작용.
det.analysis:
✅ ① cost-effective means: 비용 효율적인 수단. 원문의 핵심 표현.
❌ ② mandatory requirement: 필수 요건. 부적절.
❌ ③ significant obstacle: 장애물. 반대 의미.
❌ ④ temporary solution: 임시 해결책. 원문에 없는 내용.
det.tip: cost-effective = 비용 효율적인. means = 수단

questions.stem: 윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: 시트콤이 1950년대 초반부터 사회적 갈등을 유머로 다루었다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② 시트콤은 유머를 통해 사회적 쟁점을 다루었다: 원문 'addressed through humour'. 일치.
❌ ① 시트콤은 1970년대부터 시작되었다: 원문은 early 1950s.
❌ ③ 편견적 인물은 변화를 적극 수용했다: 원문은 resisted(저항).
❌ ④ 시트콤은 주로 경제 문제를 다루었다: 시민권, 이민, 다문화주의 등.
det.tip: 시기 확인: early 1950s = 1950년대 초반

ch: 시트콤은 유머를 통해 사회적 쟁점을 다루었다.

det.korean: 편견적 인물이 자신의 어리석음이나 타인의 꾸지람으로 조롱당했다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ 편견적 인물은 어리석음이나 꾸지람으로 기세가 꺾였다: 원문 'cut down through stupidity, scolding'. 일치.
❌ ① 편견적 인물은 존경받는 위치에 올랐다: 원문은 ridiculous(우스꽝스럽게).
❌ ② 시트콤의 유머는 비용이 많이 들었다: 원문은 cost-effective(비용 효율적).
❌ ③ 편견적 인물은 타인의 칭찬을 받았다: 원문은 scolding(꾸지람).

ch: 편견적 인물은 어리석음이나 꾸지람으로 기세가 꺾였다.

det.korean: 시트콤이 보수적 가치 확산에 기여했다는 것은 불일치.
det.analysis:
✅ ② 시트콤의 유머는 보수적 가치를 더 수용 가능하게 만들었다: 원문은 progressive(진보적) 가치. 불일치.
❌ ① 시트콤은 1950년대 초반부터 시작되었다: 원문 'early 1950s'. 일치.
❌ ③ 편견적 인물은 우스꽝스럽게 보이도록 만들어졌다: 원문 'made to appear ridiculous'. 일치.

det.tip: progressive(진보적) ≠ conservative(보수적). 핵심 단어 변조 주의.

questions.stem: 윗글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 유머를 통해 사회적 관용을 증진하는 미국 TV 시트콤의 역할.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ 유머를 통해 사회적 관용을 증진하는 미국 TV 시트콤의 역할: 핵심 주제.
❌ ① 1950년대 미국 사회의 주요 사회적 갈등: 갈등은 소재이지 주제가 아님.
❌ ② TV 시트콤의 비용 절감 효과: 비용 효율성은 사회적 효과를 설명하는 표현.
❌ ④ 미국 TV 코미디의 역사적 발전 과정: 역사보다 유머의 사회적 기능이 핵심.
det.tip: 주제 = '유머 → 사회적 관용 증진'.

questions.stem: 윗글의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 시트콤의 유머가 사회 변화를 이끈 역할을 나타내는 제목.
det.analysis:
✅ ① The Social Role of TV Sitcoms: TV 시트콤의 사회적 역할. 글의 핵심을 정확히 반영.
❌ ② The History of American Comedy: 미국 코미디의 역사. 역사가 주제가 아님.
❌ ③ Why Bigots Are Funny: 왜 편견이 심한 사람들이 재미있는가. 부분적 내용.
❌ ④ The Economics of Television: TV의 경제학. 문맥과 무관.
det.tip: 제목 = 글의 핵심 내용을 간결하게 표현. 'social role'이 핵심.

ch: The Social Role of TV Sitcoms

questions.passage: Since their start in the early 1950s U.S. television sitcoms have charted many of the social conflicts in U.S. society: civil rights, women's rights in the home and in the workplace, children's rights, immigration and multiculturalism, as well as evolving conceptions of the family. They were <u>cut down</u> either through their own stupidity, a brief scolding from others, or both. questions.stem: 밑줄 친 'cut down'이 이 글에서 함축하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: cut down = (기세를) 꺾다, 체면을 잃게 하다. 이 글에서는 편견적 인물이 유머를 통해 공개적으로 망신당하고 위축되는 것을 의미.
det.analysis:
✅ ② 유머를 통해 공개적으로 망신당하고 위축됨: 편견적 인물이 어리석음이나 꾸지람으로 체면을 잃는다는 문맥.
❌ ① 물리적으로 공격당함: cut down의 글자 그대로의 의미이지만 문맥에 맞지 않음.
❌ ③ 방송에서 편집당함: TV 제작 관련 의미로 이 문맥에 부적절.
❌ ④ 경제적 손실을 입음: 비용 관련 의미로 문맥과 무관.
det.tip: cut down = ① (나무를) 베다 ② (사람의) 기세를 꺾다, 모욕하다. 여기서는 ②의 의미.

questions.passage: Since their start in the early 1950s U.S. television sitcoms have charted many of the social conflicts in U.S. society: civil rights, women's rights in the home and in the workplace, children's rights, immigration and multiculturalism, as well as evolving conceptions of the family. Each of these issues has been addressed through humour in a way that has helped to make more progressive values more acceptable than previously. Often a character, usually someone marked as a bigot, resisted one or more of these developments and was then made to appear ridiculous. <u>They</u> were cut down either through their own stupidity, a brief scolding from others, or both. In this way, the humour of sitcoms acted as a cost-effective means to encourage acceptance of a more pluralistic and tolerant society.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 'They'가 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: They = 앞 문장의 주어인 편견적 인물(characters marked as bigots)을 가리킴.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 편견이 심한 인물(bigoted characters): 앞 문장에서 bigot으로 표시된 인물이 저항하고 우스꽝스럽게 보인다고 했으므로, They는 이 인물들.
❌ ② 시트콤 제작자들: 제작자는 언급되지 않음.
❌ ③ 사회적 갈등들: 갈등은 사물이지 사람이 아님(cut down 불가).
